facts.text: As part of the Guilford Edge, Guilford College offers a three-week intensive term each spring where students focus on a single immersion course or project.

sources.title: Students love Guilford's latest 3-week session
sources.quote: Guilford has been offering three-week terms twice each academic year as part of the Guilford Edge initiative that was launched in 2019. Beginning in 2023-24, the 3-week term will only be offered in the spring
